title: Servicing Calendar Credit Table — Early Deferral Requests on Equipment & Vehicle Loans
content:
**Rule.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans deferral fee carries an early-request credit set by the days from the grant date to the due date of the installment deferred: 25.00 is taken off for 30 days or more, 10.00 for 20 to 29 days, and nothing for fewer than 20 days. The credit is taken off the deferral fee after every multiplication of the fee has been made; the total is rounded once to cents and is never less than zero.

## The days counted

The calendar days from the grant date to the due date of the installment deferred — the loan's next due date on record when the deferral is granted.

| Days from the grant date to the due date | Amount (USD) |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | -25.00 |
| 20 to 29 | -10.00 |
| fewer than 20 | 0 |

## Both sides of each line (hypothetical due date 31 May)

| Grant date | Days to the due date | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 30 | -25.00 |
| 2 May | 29 | -10.00 |
| 11 May | 20 | -10.00 |
| 12 May | 19 | 0 |
